proof_body:
by
  intro f g c m n hf hg hm hn
  have e1 : meromorphicOrderAt f c = ((m : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by
    rw [hf.meromorphicOrderAt_eq, hm]; rfl
  have e2 : meromorphicOrderAt g c = ((n : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by
    rw [hg.meromorphicOrderAt_eq, hn]; rfl
  have e3 : (fun z => f z / g z) = fun z => f z * (g z)⁻¹ := by
    funext z; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have e4 : meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => f z * (g z)⁻¹) c = meromorphicOrderAt f c + meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (g z)⁻¹) c := meromorphicOrderAt_mul hf.meromorphicAt hg.meromorphicAt.inv
  have e5 : meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (g z)⁻¹) c = -meromorphicOrderAt g c := meromorphicOrderAt_inv
  rw [e3, e4, e5, e1, e2, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rfl
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (m n : ℕ), AnalyticAt ℂ f c → AnalyticAt ℂ g c → analyticOrderAt f c = m → analyticOrderAt g c = n → meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => f z / g z) c = (((m : ℤ) - (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
